docTitle: Kaartete aana Qullaawu Maxaafi · Qullaawa Maxaafa mitto laˀˀate
metaDesc: Gede Gondoorote yanna, Yesuusi heeshshonna Phaawuloosi haˀˀo halaalaame kaartete aana harunsi — Qullaawu Maxaafi halaalaame darguwa aana ikkino.

s.title: Kaartete aana Qullaawu Maxaafi
s.verse: “Mootichinke Yesuusi Kiristoosi wolqanna layinkimeeshshi daasire kullummo'ne yannara, ayirrinyesi illenkenni la'neeti ikkinnina, mannu hayyonni kalanqoonni maatto hoode ha'ratenni di"ikkino.” (Layinki Pheexiroosi 1:16)
s.purpose: Qullaawu Maxaafi moohaminyo diˀˀino. Halaalaame darguwa, barruwanna manna aana haˀˀino manni borro. Konne doogubba kaartete aana, yannate garinni harunsi — mitto darga xamme, woy ▶ xamme lekka lekkanni saˀˀe laˀˀi.
s.ot_lead: Mitte haˀˀo diˀˀino, kalaqamiunni kayise gatote xage juuwaati: kalaqamanna burco → duˀonna Baabeeli → woshsho (Abirihaami) → qaale afiˀrino baatto → Fulo → baˀˀu gobba → adha → gashshooti → baˀˀa → worohaˀˀu → higa.
s.je_lead: Dancha Duduwi kulanno garinni, Yesuusi heeshsho harunsi — Beeteliheemete ilamasinni kayise, cuˀˀamasinna Galiila soqqanshosi widoonni, Samaariya saˀˀe, Yerusaalamete masqalu, kaˀˀanna alira haˀˀa geeshsha.
s.pa_lead: Yerusaalamete Phenxeqoosxetenni kayise, Dancha Duduwi Yihudanni saˀˀe hiittoonni faffino — Shiima Asiyanna Awuroopa widoonni Aamilu wodana geeshsha. Onte haˀˀowiinni mitto doori (umi·layinki·sayikki + Roome haˀˀanno markaabu haˀˀo + fulinohunni gedensaanni) doogo aana borreessamino sokkuwa ledo Soqqamaasinete Looso coyibba harunsi.
s.foot: Bue · Darga sˀuwa Qullaawu Maxaafi borronna nabbahaanchu Qullaawu Maxaafi baattote egenno harunsitino (kaaˀˀanno base xaˀmmu suˀma ledo). Baaru qacce, lagoyyenna baaruwa faˀino baattote daata (Natural Earth)nni loosantino, shoshshontino.

eden.name: Edene (Kalaqama · Burco)
eden.note: Lowo geeshsha dancha ikke kalaqamino alamera, cubbo eˀˀe Maganunna mannu ooso mereero noo xaˀmma diigino.
events: Lamala barri kalaqo — “lowo geeshsha dancha ikkitino”
Umi Dancha Duduwi qaale — “meyate sirchcho sirchchote umo cancananno”

noah.name: Araaraati (Duˀo)
noah.note: Cubbunni woˀmino alame Maganu yoˀrino, ikkollana mitte maatenni heeshsho gatisino.
events: Wojju gondooro — “qoleesse duˀonni baattote geeshsha didiigamanno”

babel.name: Baabeeli Adhaba
babel.note: Iima geeshsha iˀˀanno naaxxinynyara, Maganu afoonsanna dagana baattote aana faffisino.
events: Dagu baattote aana faffino (Shineeaari — gedensaanni Baabiloone)

ur.name: Uuri
ur.note: Qullaawu Maxaafi gatote xage mittu manchi woshsho aana hanafanno.
events: “Wolqaataame gosa asseemmohe … daga baalanti ate widoonni maassantanno”

haran.name: Haaraani
haran.note: Doogo aana, qaale afiˀrino baattowa woshsho macciishshe haˀˀanni.

shechem.name: Sheekeemi · Kanaani
shechem.note: Qaale afiˀrino baattora maati xintantino, gondoorono ilamatenni ilamate saˀˀanno.
events: Kanaani eˀˀe, umi kakkalote darga — “tenne baatto sirchokkira uyeemmo”
Yaiqoobi tonne lamela beetto — tonne lamela dagate xinta

egypt.name: Gibitse (Goosheeni)
egypt.note: Maati wolqaataame gosa ikkitanno — hakkiinni borojjichcho gosa.
events: Hirtino Yooseefi, Gibitse gashsha geeshsha kaˀˀino
Yaiqoobi maati baala hoolara Gibitse dirtino

sinai.name: Siinaayi Ilaˀlo
sinai.note: Gede Gondoorote ledishshu gatto — borojjichcho Maganu umisi daga ikkanno.

kadesh.name: Qaadeesi (baˀˀu gobba)
kadesh.note: Ammanikkinni mitte ilama baatto hooggino — ikkollana Maganu ledonsa gattino.
events: Tonne lamela laˀisiisaano — ikkollana mannu ammana giwino
38 dirra baˀˀu gobbara — manna, maannenna giira

jericho.name: Yarikoo
jericho.note: Goofimarchira qaale afiˀrino baatto eˀˀe adhino.

shiloh.name: Siiloo (Ejjeetto)
shiloh.note: Moote nookkihunni, mannu baalu lawisi gede assino — addu moote hasiissino.
events: Ruuti — goˀˀakkii barra halaalimma, Daawiti sirchchora

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame · Gambooshshe Gashshooti
jerusalem.note: Israeele aleenya yanna — hegere moote qaalenono ledo.
events: Umi moote Saaooli, hakkiinni Daawitinna Gooliyaadi

samaria.name: Samaariya · Baˀˀino Gashshooti
samaria.note: Gashshooti baˀˀe woriidi haˀˀanno, himanaano caamme.
events: Selemooni gedensaanni, Yihudanna Israeele ikke baˀˀa
Eliyaasi, Isayaasi, Ermiyaasi “higge” yee caamme — Iˀˀeuno kulino

nineveh.name: Nineve (Asoore)
nineveh.note: Baala amaale agurte, awurai balaxe baˀˀino.

babylon.name: Baabiloone
babylon.note: Roore diikko hashsha — ikkollana qolote qaale gattino.
events: Daanieelinna Hiziqeeli — worohaˀˀu giddo ammananna ajuuja

susa.name: Suusa (Faarso)
susa.note: Kaˀikalaqo bayru gashshooti wodana aananna, Maganu dagasi agarino.

return.name: Yerusaalame higa
return.note: Higge wodantino — ikkollana moote diˀˀino daino. Iˀˀeu agartanni no.
events: Qiiroosi hajajonni sasu higa (Zerubaabeeli 538 · Izira 458 · Nehimiya 444)
Qullaawu Mine wodarantino, Yerusaalame daawaro qolamino

bethlehem.name: Beeteliheeme
bethlehem.note: Qaale uyinoonni Iˀˀeu Daawiti katama daˀˀino — Qaali maala ikkino.

nazareth.name: Naazireeti
events: Tonne lamela diri ikke, Qullaawu Mine giddo xaˀminanna qolanni
Gedensaanni ilama katamasi gambooshshe minera giwamino

jordan.name: Yordaanoosi Lagi
jordan.note: Cinaanchu soqqanshosi hanafanno — iima Beetto ikkasi cinaˀˀanno.
events: Qullaawu Ayyaani worqeemma gede woroidi dirino — “Kuni baxaanchu Beettoˀyaati”
Baˀˀu gobbara Sheexaane sasu fanxe qeelino

sychar.name: Sikaari (Samaariya)
sychar.note: Hanafote soqqansho doogo — Yerusaalame saˀˀe, heseynoonni Samaariya geeshsha.

capernaum.name: Qifirnaahoomi
capernaum.note: Galiila soqqanshote xinti darga — woshsho, rosiisanna gibba baalanti kawa gamba yaanno.
events: Ilaˀlo aana rosiisi — “ayyaani widoonni buˀˀo ikkitinori maassamootoho”

galilee.name: Galiila Baaro
galilee.note: Kalaqama aana noo wolqanni ayeeta ikkasi leellishanno.
events: Onte daabbonna lame qulxuˀminni 5,000 manna sagalino

caesarea_p.name: Qeesaariya Filiphi
caesarea_p.note: Rosaano isi Kiristoosi ikkasi huwatino, masqalete doogono fanantino.
events: Pheexiroosi xaadooshsho — “Ati Kiristoosihoˀne, heeˀraanchu Maganu Beettoho”

jericho.name: Yarikoo
jericho.note: Yerusaalame aliidi haˀˀino doogo aana, baˀino hasanno.

bethany.name: Biixaaniya
bethany.note: Goofimarchu lamalasi albaanni reyo aana wolqasi leellishino.

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame
jerusalem.note: Qullaawu Maxaafi baala farciˀrinohu goofa — masqalu, kaˀˀanna alira haˀˀa.
events: Ayirrinyunni eˀˀe; qoleesse Qullaawu Mine giddonni daaqamaano fushshino
Sasimi barra kaˀˀe, hakkiinni alira haˀˀino

antioch.name: Anxookiya
antioch.note: Aammu soqqanshora soyanno songo — konniwa hanafannono higannono.
events: Huuccatto giddo Ayyaani Barnaabaasanna Saaoolo doorino
Umi, layinkinna sayikki haˀˀo hanafamanno darga

salamis.name: Salaamisi (Qifiroosi)
salamis.note: Qifiroosira umi uurro — gambooshshe minuwara duduwino.

perga.name: Perge
perga.note: Pamfiliya doonyo — konni Yohaannisi Maarqoosi higino.

pantioch.name: Fisiidiya Anxookiya
events: Gambooshshe minera gatote xage seeda rosiisa

iconium.name: Iqooniyoni
iconium.note: Lowohu ammanino, ikkollana qarrisa haˀˀa assino.

lystra.name: Lisxira
lystra.note: Magano yine woshshamino, hakkiinni kinniˀraminohu daino.
events: Mannu magaanoota yine sarxa uyate woˀnaˀˀino

derbe.name: Darbe
derbe.note: Lowo rosaano assino; songuwa jawaachisha doogonsa higantino.

troas.name: Xiroohaadi
troas.note: Dancha Duduwo umo Awuroopa widira haˀˀanno soorramate darga.

philippi.name: Filiphi
philippi.note: Awuroopu umi songo — gordo giddono Dancha Duduwo qeelino.
events: Cootimma ayyaani amaddinose borojjo meyate feyino
Hashsha faarso, baattu qaacco, gordo agaraanchu maati gatino

berea.name: Beeriya
events: Halaalenna ikkinota barru barrunku Qullaawa Borro buuxidhino

corinth.name: Qoronxoosi
corinth.note: Mitte diri baqqo heeˀre, busha katamira songo xintino.

ephesus.name: Efesoona
ephesus.note: Sayikki haˀˀo wodana — Qaali Asiya woˀmate faffino.
events: Xiraanoosi addaraashshera lame diri barru barrunku rosiisino

miletus.name: Miliixoosi
events: Cimeeyye qoleessite dilaˀˀanno yaano afe wiˀlino

caesarea.name: Qeesaariya
caesarea.note: Lame diri gashshaanonna moote albaanni Dancha Duduwo farciˀˀino.

jerusalem.name: Yerusaalame
jerusalem.note: Qullaawu Mine giddo amadamino, borojjichcho ikke haˀˀasi hanafino.
events: Roomu manchi ikkasinni, agarraˀˀe Qeesaariya soyamino

crete.name: Qareexe
crete.note: Fulinohunni gedensaanni, songuwa qixxeessate Tiito agurino doobbe.
events: Katama katamunku cimeeyye badate Tiito agurino

malta.name: Meliixe
malta.note: Bubbenna markaabu diigaminni, Maganu qaale uurrino.
events: “Awuraatu bubbe” markaabu diigino, ikkollana baalu 276 gatino

rome.name: Roome
rome.book: Soqqamaasinete Looso 28 · Gordo Sokkuwa · Layinki Ximootewoosi
rome.note: Dancha Duduwo goofimarchira Aamilu wodana iillino — goofa diˀˀino, hanafooti.
events: Lame diri minisira agarante, waajjikkinni Maganu gashshooti duduwino
Gedensaanni qoleesse gordo eˀˀe, Layinki Ximootewoosi borreessino, shooshamino — “dancha olo oloommo, doorsho goofoommo”
